Warn the Emperor's Hand of the Jade Brotherhood's nefarious scheme.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak with the [[Emperor's Hand]].
* Speak with [[Informant Tahzen]].
* See Guildmaster Luan for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]

===Environmental changes===
* Informant Tahzen will no longer [[spawn]] after this quest is completed.

==Walkthrough==
Head east in Kaineng Center to the [[Raisu Pavilion]] portal. Talk to the [[Emperor's Hand]], and then map travel to [[the Marketplace]]. Exit into Wajjun Bazaar and follow the quest marker to Informant Tahzen. After speaking to him, return to Kaineng Center and speak to Guildmaster Luan for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Guildmaster Luan
:''"You must go to '''[[Raisu Pavilion]]''' at the palace and find the '''Emperor's Hand'''. Warn him of the [[Jade Brotherhood]]'s assassination plot. He will know what to do."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I will relay the information to the Emperor's Hand.
|decline = I'm sure the emperor will be fine. He has guards to protect him.
|ask = This is not the time for chit-chat! You must go to '''Raisu Pavillion''' and warn the '''Emperor's Hand''' about this plot! 
|indent = :: }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Emperor's Hand
:''"With the [[Emperor Kisu|emperor]] distracted by the turmoil caused by this plague, it was only a matter of time before the Jade Brotherhood took direct action against him. Talk to Informant Tahzen. He should have some information for us. We must find out what the Jade Brotherhood is planning.''

;Informant Tahzen
:''"The shadows have eyes, and I fear my true identity has been discovered. I will be brief. The one hired to kill the emperor is a foreigner who arrived on a ship called the [[Siren's Song]]. Deliver this information swiftly. 

:''I shall see you in [[the Mists]], my friend."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Guildmaster Luan
:''"So they hired an [[Assassin]] from across the sea? It seems Informant Tahzen passed this along to you not a moment too soon. He was a brave man and will be missed. I take it from your surprised look that you have not heard? Yes, he was found dead not long ago. Thank you for your service."''
